name: RAD21 cohesin complex component
pathways: regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II

function.text: RAD21 encodes double-strand-break repair protein rad21 homolog [Cleaved into: 64-kDa C-terminal product]. Annotated molecular activities include DNA-binding transcription factor binding and chromatin binding. It participates in regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II and DNA recombination.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to Cornelia de Lange syndrome (autosomal dominant); Cornelia de Lange syndrome 4 (autosomal dominant).

somatic.text: Somatic sequence alterations have cohort-level candidate-driver evidence in Acute Myeloid Leukemia. This gene-level statistical evidence requires allele-specific review and does not establish the effect of every variant.
